title: Aktien Screener USA/EUROPA
author: Mountain-Read-6059
selftext: MD Trading is a free stock analysis site that surfaces interesting stocks beyond the big names in a single dashboard. Each stock gets an overall score based on valuation, fundamentals, market, analysts and insiders, shown as a grade, arrow and traffic light, plus a B-Score (fit with Buffett-style quality criteria) and a "Quote" (a statistical estimate of beating the market over three years). The added value is numbers instead of gut feeling, with quality and timing kept separate so every figure stays explainable. With an account you also get AI-generated market analysis, market impact, chart analysis, portfolio upload and a watchlist.
